insights.summary: Savita held no earnings call; this is from its Q4 FY26 investor presentation. FY26 consolidated total income rose 14% to ₹4,408 Cr on record volumes above 5 lakh KL (+17%), and PAT rose 61% to ₹182 Cr as EBITDA per KL recovered to ₹4,555 from ₹3,691. The company is debt-free with ~₹508 Cr of cash and investments; the chairman aims for double-digit growth in India and exports, led by the Savsol Ester5 lubricant range and new ester-based fluids.

what_changed.text: Aim for double-digit growth in India and international markets
Multi-year deal to supply Mahindra tractor genuine engine oils

tone.label: steady
tone.quote: We are pleased to report a record performance for both the quarter and for the full year, with total income growing 22% YoY in Q4FY26 and 14% for FY26

red_flags.text: No earnings call or Q&A; guidance limited to a line in the presentation.
EBITDA margin of 6.6% is still well below FY22's 13%; earnings swing with base-oil prices.
Receivables rose 18% to ₹914 Cr, faster than revenue.

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Petroleum specialty oils (transformer oils, white and mineral oils, cable-filling compounds, waxes) and Savsol lubricants for vehicles and industry
business_snapshot.customers: Transformer makers and electricity boards, personal-care and pharma firms, optic-fibre cable makers, auto OEMs (Mahindra and others), 1,500 franchise dealers and 20,000 retailers, exports to 75+ countries
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: FY26: petroleum specialty oils 73%, lubricating oils 26%; domestic 83%, exports 17%
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Power transmission and transformer build-out, personal care and pharma, vehicle population, exports
